join_order.notes: suppkey is dense 0-100K; use direct array for aggregation and join. After finding max revenue, lookup matching suppkey(s) via supplier pk index.

indexes.condition: lookup row_id for matching suppkey(s) to retrieve s_name, s_address, s_phone

scan_phase.description: Parallel block-level scan of lineitem with thread-local revenue arrays
scan_phase.merge: element-wise sum of thread-local arrays into global array

execution_phases.name: zonemap_filter
execution_phases.description: Load lineitem_l_shipdate_zonemap. Build list of qualifying block indices where block overlaps [9497, 9588).

execution_phases.name: parallel_scan_aggregate
execution_phases.description: Each thread has thread-local double revenue[max_suppkey+1] zeroed. For qualifying blocks: scan l_shipdate, for rows in [9497, 9588): revenue[l_suppkey[i]] += l_extendedprice[i] * (1.0 - l_discount[i]). After scan, merge thread-local arrays via element-wise addition.

execution_phases.name: find_max
execution_phases.description: Single pass over revenue[0..max_suppkey] to find max_revenue. Then collect all suppkeys where fabs(revenue[sk] - max_revenue) < 1e-6.

execution_phases.name: lookup_supplier
execution_phases.description: For each matching suppkey, use supplier_s_suppkey_lookup to get row_id. Read s_name, s_address, s_phone from supplier varlen columns at that row_id.

mmap_strategy.resource_scoping: declare mmap before RAII timer to exclude munmap TLB shootdown
